description: Keeps agent-driven live testing off the machine the operator works on. Anything that launches or relaunches an app, fires dictation, posts synthetic input events, changes focus, sets a machine-global input/audio override, or opens the mic runs only on the dedicated runner machine — and only against a permission grant recorded in the plan at planning time. Headless work (builds, unit tests, lint, read-only queries) stays on the dev machine.
name: live-testing-guard
